title: Initialize TypeScript project structure for the Penpot-to-HTML converter
description: Create the folder structure and TypeScript configuration for the converter. The project should live under `src/converter/`. Create `tsconfig.json` at the project root targeting ES2022, with `moduleResolution: bundler` (or `node16`), `strict: true`, and source maps enabled. Create `src/converter/index.ts` as the main barrel that re-exports the public API. No runtime behavior yet — just scaffolding.

title: Define the ConverterContext interface and main entry-point signatures
description: Create `src/converter/types.ts`. Define `ConverterContext` which carries: `resolveImageUrl(id: Uuid): string` (returns a URL or data-URI for a Penpot image asset), `baseUrl?: string` (optional prefix for image URLs), and `tailwindMode: 'cdn' | 'none'` (whether to inject the Tailwind CDN script). Also export `convertPage(page: Page, ctx: ConverterContext): string` and `convertShape(shape: Shape, allObjects: Record<string, Shape>, ctx: ConverterContext): string` as function signatures (stubs that throw `new Error('not implemented')` for now). Import `Page`, `Shape`, `Uuid` from `../penpot.types`.

title: Build the shape tree from the flat Page.objects record
description: Create `src/converter/tree.ts`. Implement `buildTree(objects: Record<string, Shape>): Shape` which: (1) finds the root frame (the shape whose `parentId` equals its own `id`, or the frame that is not referenced as a child by any other shape), (2) attaches a `_children: Shape[]` array to each shape in the correct z-order (preserving the `shapes: Uuid[]` array order from GroupShape/FrameShape/BoolShape), (3) returns the root. Use a non-mutating approach — build a `Map<Uuid, Shape & { _children: Shape[] }>` and do not modify the original objects. Export also `getChildren(shape: Shape, objects: Record<string, Shape>): Shape[]` as a helper.

title: Utility: convert HexColor + opacity to a CSS color string
description: Create `src/converter/utils/color.ts`. Implement `hexOpacityToCss(hex: HexColor, opacity?: number): string`. If opacity is `undefined` or `1`, return the hex string as-is. Otherwise convert the hex to RGB components and return `rgba(r, g, b, opacity)`. Handle both 3-digit (#RGB) and 6-digit (#RRGGBB) hex strings. Export the function. Write a short inline JSDoc. No external dependencies.

title: Utility: convert a GeomMatrix to a CSS matrix() transform string
description: Create `src/converter/utils/transform.ts`. Implement `matrixToCss(m: GeomMatrix): string` which returns `matrix(a, b, c, d, e, f)` rounded to 4 decimal places. Also implement `isIdentityMatrix(m: GeomMatrix): boolean` that returns true when the matrix is the identity (a≈1, b≈0, c≈0, d≈1, e≈0, f≈0 within a small epsilon of 1e-4). Use these later to skip emitting a transform when it is the identity. No external dependencies.

title: Utility: convert a numeric pixel value to a Tailwind arbitrary value class token
description: Create `src/converter/utils/tailwind.ts`. Implement `px(value: number): string` which returns a string like `[120px]` (to be embedded in Tailwind classes like `w-[120px]`). Implement `pxClass(prefix: string, value: number): string` which returns e.g. `w-[120px]` given prefix `'w'` and value `120`. Round values to 2 decimal places and omit the decimal if it is `.00`. This utility will be used throughout all shape-to-class converters.

title: Utility: build a CSS inline-style string from a plain object
description: Create `src/converter/utils/style.ts`. Implement `buildStyle(props: Record<string, string | number | undefined | null>): string` which iterates the object, skips falsy/null/undefined values, and concatenates entries as `key: value;` (kebab-case keys, space after colon). Return the full inline style string, e.g. `'position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 20px;'`. Also implement `mergeStyles(...parts: string[]): string` that joins multiple partial style strings safely.

title: Utility: build a Tailwind class string from an array of conditional class tokens
description: In `src/converter/utils/tailwind.ts` (same file as task 6), add `cls(...tokens: (string | false | undefined | null)[]): string` which filters out falsy values and joins the rest with a single space. This mirrors the popular `clsx` / `cx` pattern and will be the standard way to build Tailwind class strings throughout the converter. Keep the function pure and without external dependencies.

title: Utility: safely escape text content for HTML output
description: In `src/converter/utils/html.ts`, implement `escapeHtml(text: string): string` that replaces `&` → `&`, `<` → `<`, `>` → `>`, `"` → `"`, `'` → `'`. Also implement `tag(name: string, attrs: Record<string, string | undefined>, children?: string): string` which builds an HTML tag string. If `children` is undefined the tag is self-closing. Attributes with `undefined` values are omitted.

title: Implement solid fill conversion to Tailwind background-color class
description: Create `src/converter/visual/fills.ts`. Implement `solidFillToClass(fill: Fill): string` which reads `fill.fillColor` and `fill.fillOpacity` and returns a Tailwind arbitrary background class like `bg-[rgba(255,0,0,0.5)]` or `bg-[#ff0000]`. If no fill color is present, return an empty string. Use `hexOpacityToCss` from utils/color.ts. This handles the common single-color fill case.

title: Implement linear gradient fill conversion to CSS background inline style
description: In `src/converter/visual/fills.ts`, implement `linearGradientToStyle(gradient: Gradient): string` which converts a Penpot linear gradient to a CSS `background: linear-gradient(...)` inline style string. The Penpot gradient encodes start/end as relative coordinates (0–1) within the shape bounding box mapped to an angle. Compute the angle from `(startX, startY)` to `(endX, endY)` using `Math.atan2`. Map each `GradientStop` to `rgba(...)  offset%`. Return the full CSS property string ready to be embedded in a `style` attribute.

title: Implement radial gradient fill conversion to CSS background inline style
description: In `src/converter/visual/fills.ts`, implement `radialGradientToStyle(gradient: Gradient): string`. Penpot radial gradients encode center via `(startX, startY)` and radius via the distance to `(endX, endY)`. Map these to a CSS `radial-gradient(circle at X% Y%, ...)` value. Stops are the same format as linear. Return the full `background: ...` CSS property string. Handle the edge case where start and end are the same point by defaulting to a centered circle.

title: Implement image fill conversion to CSS background-image inline style
description: In `src/converter/visual/fills.ts`, implement `imageFillToStyle(fill: Fill, ctx: ConverterContext): string` which: (1) reads `fill.fillImage` (type `ImageColor`), (2) calls `ctx.resolveImageUrl(fill.fillImage.id)` to get the URL, (3) returns a CSS string with `background-image: url('...')`, `background-size: cover`, `background-position: center`, and optionally `background-repeat: no-repeat`. If `fillImage.keepAspectRatio` is `true`, use `background-size: contain` instead.

title: Implement fill dispatcher that resolves the correct fill strategy for a shape
description: In `src/converter/visual/fills.ts`, implement `fillsToOutput(fills: Fill[] | null | undefined, ctx: ConverterContext): { classes: string; style: string }`. Iterate over all fills (Penpot supports multiple overlapping fills). For each fill, dispatch to `solidFillToClass`, `linearGradientToStyle`, `radialGradientToStyle`, or `imageFillToStyle` based on which field is present (`fillColorGradient.type`, `fillImage`, `fillColor`). Accumulate CSS classes and inline style properties for multiple fills using CSS layered backgrounds where needed.

title: Implement solid stroke conversion to Tailwind border classes
description: Create `src/converter/visual/strokes.ts`. Implement `solidStrokeToClasses(stroke: Stroke): { classes: string; style: string }`. Map `strokeWidth` to `border-[Npx]`, `strokeColor`+`strokeOpacity` to `border-[color]` using arbitrary values. Map `strokeStyle` to Tailwind border-style classes: `solid` → `border-solid`, `dashed` → `border-dashed`, `dotted` → `border-dotted`. For `strokeAlignment` of `'inner'` or `'outer'`, note that standard CSS border is `'center'`-equivalent; for inner/outer use `box-shadow` as an inline style instead.

title: Implement stroke alignment: inner and outer via box-shadow inline style
description: In `src/converter/visual/strokes.ts`, implement `strokeAlignmentToStyle(stroke: Stroke): string`. For `strokeAlignment === 'inner'`, emit `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 Npx color`. For `strokeAlignment === 'outer'`, emit `box-shadow: 0 0 0 Npx color`. For `strokeAlignment === 'center'` (default), return empty string (handled by standard CSS border). This avoids layout shifts caused by border box-model. Use `hexOpacityToCss` for the color.

title: Implement drop-shadow conversion to Tailwind shadow or CSS box-shadow
description: Create `src/converter/visual/shadows.ts`. Implement `shadowToStyle(shadow: Shadow): string`. For `shadow.style === 'drop-shadow'`, produce `box-shadow: offsetX offsetY blurRadius spreadRadius color`. For `'inner-shadow'`, prefix with `inset `. Use `hexOpacityToCss` for `shadow.color`. Skip hidden shadows (`shadow.hidden === true`). If the shape has multiple shadows, join them with `, ` in a single `box-shadow` multi-value property.

title: Implement blur conversion to Tailwind filter classes
description: Create `src/converter/visual/blur.ts`. Implement `blurToClass(blur: Blur | undefined): string`. If `blur` is absent or `blur.hidden === true`, return `''`. For `blur.type === 'layer-blur'` (standard blur), return `blur-[Npx]` using `blur.value`. For `blur.type === 'background-blur'`, return `backdrop-blur-[Npx]` instead. Round the value to 1 decimal place.

title: Implement blend mode conversion to Tailwind mix-blend-mode class
description: Create `src/converter/visual/blend.ts`. Implement `blendModeToClass(mode: BlendMode | undefined): string`. Map each `BlendMode` value to its Tailwind equivalent (e.g., `'multiply'` → `'mix-blend-multiply'`, `'screen'` → `'mix-blend-screen'`, etc.). If mode is `'normal'` or `undefined`, return `''` to avoid emitting a redundant class. Use a lookup record/map for the mapping, typed so TypeScript complains if a `BlendMode` variant is missing.

title: Implement opacity conversion to Tailwind opacity class
description: In `src/converter/visual/blend.ts`, implement `opacityToClass(opacity: number | undefined): string`. If `opacity` is `undefined` or equals `1`, return `''`. Otherwise multiply by 100, round to the nearest integer, and return `opacity-[N%]` (e.g., `opacity-[50%]`). Note that Tailwind 3+ supports `opacity-50` for standard values — use `opacity-[N%]` with the arbitrary value for full coverage of non-standard values.

title: Implement corner radius conversion to Tailwind or inline-style border-radius
description: Create `src/converter/visual/radius.ts`. Implement `radiusToOutput(shape: ShapeCommon): { classes: string; style: string }`. If all four radii (`r1`, `r2`, `r3`, `r4`) are equal (or all are `undefined`), emit a single `rounded-[Npx]` class with the common value. If they differ, emit an inline style `border-radius: r1px r2px r3px r4px` following the CSS order (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left matching Penpot's r1–r4 labeling). Treat missing radii as `0`.

title: Implement shape rotation to Tailwind rotate class or CSS transform
description: Create `src/converter/visual/position.ts`. Implement `rotationToClass(rotation: number | undefined): string`. If `rotation` is `undefined` or `0`, return `''`. Otherwise return `rotate-[Ndeg]` (e.g., `rotate-[45deg]`). Note that Penpot stores rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise. CSS `rotate` is clockwise — negate the value. Also implement `transformToStyle(transform: GeomMatrix): string` which returns a `transform: matrix(...)` inline style string if the matrix is not identity, using the utils from task 5.

title: Implement hidden-shape handling
description: In `src/converter/visual/blend.ts`, implement `hiddenToClass(hidden: boolean | undefined): string` which returns `'hidden'` (Tailwind `display: none`) if `hidden === true`, otherwise `''`. This will be included in every shape's class list. Hidden shapes should still be emitted to the HTML output (with the `hidden` class) rather than being excluded entirely, preserving DOM structure for potential JS consumers.

title: Implement a shared base-classes builder for all shapes
description: Create `src/converter/visual/base.ts`. Implement `baseClasses(shape: ShapeCommon, ctx: ConverterContext): { classes: string; style: string }` which aggregates: rotation class, opacity class, blend mode class, hidden class, blur class, shadow style, and corner radius output. This is a single call that returns everything needed by all shape renderers for the common visual properties. Each individual converter was built in prior tasks — this function just composes them.

title: Implement absolute positioning: emit position and size Tailwind classes
description: In `src/converter/visual/position.ts`, implement `absolutePositionClasses(shape: ShapeCommon): string` which returns `absolute left-[Xpx] top-[Ypx] w-[Wpx] h-[Hpx]` using values from `shape.x`, `shape.y`, `shape.width`, `shape.height` (all via the `pxClass` utility). This is used when a shape is a direct child of a non-layout frame (absolute positioning context) or when `layoutItemAbsolute === true` inside a flex/grid container.

title: Implement horizontal constraints to CSS left/right/width logic
description: In `src/converter/visual/position.ts`, implement `constraintsHToStyle(shape: ShapeCommon, parent: ShapeCommon): string` which converts `shape.constraintsH` into appropriate CSS. For `'left'` → `left: Xpx`. For `'right'` → `right: (parentWidth - x - width)px`. For `'center'` → `left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%)`. For `'leftright'` → `left: Xpx; right: (parentWidth - x - width)px; width: unset`. For `'scale'` → `left: X%; width: W%` as percentages of parent width.

title: Implement vertical constraints to CSS top/bottom/height logic
description: In `src/converter/visual/position.ts`, implement `constraintsVToStyle(shape: ShapeCommon, parent: ShapeCommon): string` mirroring the horizontal constraints (task 26) but for the vertical axis. For `'top'` / `'bottom'` / `'center'` / `'topbottom'` / `'scale'`, produce equivalent CSS for `top`, `bottom`, and `height`. Both constraint functions will be called together for shapes inside non-layout frames.

title: Implement RectShape renderer
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/rect.ts`. Implement `renderRect(shape: RectShape, parent: ShapeCommon | null, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. Emit a `<div>` with: absolute position classes, base visual classes (fills, strokes, shadows, radius, opacity, blur, blend), and `relative` if it has no children. Use the `tag` utility from utils/html.ts. No children are expected from a rect — it is a leaf node.

title: Implement CircleShape renderer
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/circle.ts`. Implement `renderCircle(shape: CircleShape, parent: ShapeCommon | null, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. A circle in Penpot is stored as `type: 'circle'` (ellipse). Emit a `<div>` with `rounded-full` if `width === height` (perfect circle), otherwise emit `border-radius: 50%` as inline style. Apply all base visual properties: fills, strokes, shadows, opacity, blend mode, blur. Use absolute positioning.

title: Implement ImageShape renderer
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/image.ts`. Implement `renderImage(shape: ImageShape, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. Call `ctx.resolveImageUrl(shape.metadata.id)` to get the image URL. Emit an `` tag with `src`, `width`, `height` attributes, `alt=""` (decorative), `class` with absolute position classes, opacity, blend mode, and an inline style for any rotation/transform. If the shape has fills, they should be ignored (fills on an image shape only blend over the image — skip for simplicity).

title: Implement PathShape renderer using inline SVG
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/path.ts`. Implement `renderPath(shape: PathShape, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. Emit an `<svg>` element sized to the shape's bounding box (`width` × `height`), positioned absolutely. Inside, emit a `<path d="...">` using `shape.content`. Translate the path coordinates so the path starts at `(0, 0)` within the SVG by applying a `transform="translate(-x, -y)"` to the `<path>`. Apply fill color from `shape.fills` as `fill` attribute, stroke from `shape.strokes` as `stroke` attribute.

title: Implement BoolShape renderer using inline SVG
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/bool.ts`. Implement `renderBool(shape: BoolShape, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. `BoolShape` stores the result of boolean operations (union/subtract/intersect/exclude) as a flattened SVG path string in `shape.content`. Emit an `<svg>` with the bounding box dimensions, positioned absolutely. Inside, render `<path d={shape.content}>` with fill and stroke from the shape's `fills` and `strokes` arrays. Use the same SVG translate approach as the PathShape renderer.

title: Implement SvgRawShape renderer embedding raw SVG content
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/svg-raw.ts`. Implement `renderSvgRaw(shape: SvgRawShape, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. Wrap `shape.content` (which is a complete SVG string) inside a `<div>` that is absolutely positioned and sized to the shape bounding box. Set the inner div's `innerHTML` equivalent to the raw SVG. Apply opacity, blend mode, and rotation from base classes. Note: the raw SVG may contain `<script>` tags — strip any `<script>` elements and `on*` event attributes from the raw content before embedding for XSS safety.

title: Implement GroupShape renderer as a relative-positioned container
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/group.ts`. Implement `renderGroup(shape: GroupShape, children: Shape[], objects: Record<string, Shape>, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. Emit a `<div class="absolute" style="...">` with absolute position, width, height, opacity, blend mode, rotation. Then recursively render each child shape inside it. The group itself has no background — it only provides a containing coordinate space. Apply `maskedGroup` handling: if `shape.maskedGroup === true`, the first child acts as a clip mask — add `overflow-hidden` and apply the first child's shape as the clip (simplification: wrap in `overflow-hidden rounded` div).

title: Implement FrameShape renderer for absolute (no-layout) mode
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/frame.ts`. Implement `renderFrame(shape: FrameShape, children: Shape[], objects: Record<string, Shape>, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. When `shape.layoutType` is `undefined` or absent, render as a `<div>` with `relative` class when it is the root frame, or `absolute` when it is a nested frame. Apply `overflow-hidden` if `shape.clipContent === true`. Recursively render children inside. Apply all base visual properties (fills, radius, shadows, etc.).

title: Implement flex layout container classes for FrameShape
description: Create `src/converter/layout/flex.ts`. Implement `flexContainerClasses(shape: FrameShape): string`. Map: `layoutFlexDir` → `flex-row` / `flex-col` / `flex-row-reverse` / `flex-col-reverse` (always include `flex`). `layoutAlignItems` → `items-start` / `items-center` / `items-end` / `items-stretch` / etc. `layoutJustifyContent` → `justify-start` / `justify-center` / `justify-end` / `justify-between` / `justify-around` / `justify-evenly`. `layoutWrapType` → `flex-wrap` or `flex-nowrap`. Emit all non-default classes.

title: Implement flex layout gap and padding to Tailwind classes
description: In `src/converter/layout/flex.ts`, implement `flexSpacingClasses(shape: FrameShape): { classes: string; style: string }`. For `layoutRowGap` and `layoutColumnGap`: if they are equal emit `gap-[Npx]`, otherwise emit `gap-x-[Npx] gap-y-[Npx]`. For `layoutPadding` (type `LayoutPadding` with `p1`–`p4` top/right/bottom/left): if all equal emit `p-[Npx]`, if top=bottom and left=right emit `px-[Npx] py-[Npx]`, otherwise fall back to an inline `padding: p1px p2px p3px p4px` style.

title: Implement layout item sizing (fill/fix/auto) for flex children
description: Create `src/converter/layout/layout-item.ts`. Implement `layoutItemSizingClasses(shape: ShapeCommon): string`. Read `shape.layoutItemHSizing` and `shape.layoutItemVSizing`. For `'fill'` → `flex-1` (or `w-full` / `h-full` depending on axis). For `'auto'` → no explicit size class. For `'fix'` → `w-[Npx] h-[Npx]` using the shape's actual dimensions. Combine horizontal and vertical sizing into a single class string. The `layoutFlexDir` of the parent is needed to distinguish main vs cross axis — accept parent as a parameter.

title: Implement layout item margins to Tailwind margin classes
description: In `src/converter/layout/layout-item.ts`, implement `layoutItemMarginClasses(shape: ShapeCommon): { classes: string; style: string }`. Read `shape.layoutItemMargin` (type `LayoutItemMargin` with `m1`–`m4` top/right/bottom/left). If `shape.layoutItemMarginType === 'simple'` and all sides equal, emit `m-[Npx]`. If top=bottom and left=right, emit `mx-[Npx] my-[Npx]`. Otherwise fall back to inline `margin: m1px m2px m3px m4px` style. If `layoutItemMargin` is undefined, return empty strings.

title: Implement layout item align-self to Tailwind self-* class
description: In `src/converter/layout/layout-item.ts`, implement `layoutItemAlignSelfClass(shape: ShapeCommon): string`. Map `shape.layoutItemAlignSelf` to Tailwind: `'start'` → `self-start`, `'center'` → `self-center`, `'end'` → `self-end`, `'stretch'` → `self-stretch`. If `undefined`, return `''`.

title: Implement layout item min/max size constraints to Tailwind classes
description: In `src/converter/layout/layout-item.ts`, implement `layoutItemMinMaxClasses(shape: ShapeCommon): string`. Map `layoutItemMinW` → `min-w-[Npx]`, `layoutItemMaxW` → `max-w-[Npx]`, `layoutItemMinH` → `min-h-[Npx]`, `layoutItemMaxH` → `max-h-[Npx]`. Skip any field that is `undefined`. Join and return all emitted classes.

title: Implement layout item z-index to Tailwind z-index class
description: In `src/converter/layout/layout-item.ts`, implement `layoutItemZIndexClass(shape: ShapeCommon): string`. If `shape.layoutItemZIndex` is defined and non-zero, return `z-[N]`. Otherwise return `''`. This is used for flex/grid children that have an explicit stacking override.

title: Implement layout item absolute positioning inside flex container
description: In `src/converter/layout/layout-item.ts`, implement `layoutItemAbsoluteClasses(shape: ShapeCommon): string`. If `shape.layoutItemAbsolute === true`, return `absolute left-[Xpx] top-[Ypx]` (using the shape's x/y relative to the flex container — Penpot stores parentX/parentY in the shape's x/y when it is absolute within a flex parent). Otherwise return `''`.

title: Implement FrameShape renderer for flex layout mode
description: In `src/converter/shapes/frame.ts`, extend `renderFrame` to handle `shape.layoutType === 'flex'`. When flex layout is active: emit `flex` plus all classes from `flexContainerClasses` and `flexSpacingClasses`. Render each child with layout-item classes (`layoutItemSizingClasses`, `layoutItemMarginClasses`, `layoutItemAlignSelfClass`, `layoutItemMinMaxClasses`, `layoutItemZIndexClass`, `layoutItemAbsoluteClasses`) wrapped around the child's own rendered output. Children should NOT receive absolute position classes from `absolutePositionClasses` (layout controls their position).

title: Implement CSS grid column and row track definitions from GridTrack[]
description: Create `src/converter/layout/grid.ts`. Implement `gridTracksToStyle(tracks: GridTrack[], axis: 'columns' | 'rows'): string` which converts an array of `GridTrack` to a CSS `grid-template-columns` or `grid-template-rows` inline style value. Map: `type: 'fixed'` → `Npx`, `type: 'percent'` → `N%`, `type: 'flex'` → `Nfr`, `type: 'auto'` → `auto`. Missing `value` defaults to `1` for flex tracks and `auto` otherwise. Join with spaces. Return full CSS property string.

title: Implement grid cell placement classes for grid children
description: In `src/converter/layout/grid.ts`, implement `gridCellClasses(cell: GridCell): string`. Map `cell.row` → `row-start-[N]`, `cell.rowSpan` → `row-span-[N]` (skip if `rowSpan === 1`), `cell.column` → `col-start-[N]`, `cell.columnSpan` → `col-span-[N]` (skip if `columnSpan === 1`). Map `cell.alignSelf` and `cell.justifySelf` to `self-*` and `justify-self-*` Tailwind classes. Return all combined classes.

title: Implement FrameShape lookup for grid cell assignment per child shape
description: In `src/converter/layout/grid.ts`, implement `findCellForShape(frame: FrameShape, shapeId: Uuid): GridCell | undefined`. `frame.layoutGridCells` is a `Record<string, GridCell>` where each cell has a `shapes: Uuid[]` array listing which shape UUIDs occupy that cell. Iterate over all cells and return the cell whose `shapes` array includes `shapeId`. This is called when rendering grid children to look up their cell placement.

title: Implement FrameShape renderer for grid layout mode
description: In `src/converter/shapes/frame.ts`, extend `renderFrame` to handle `shape.layoutType === 'grid'`. Emit `grid` class and inline styles for `grid-template-columns`, `grid-template-rows` (from task 45), plus gap classes. For each child, call `findCellForShape` (task 47) to get the cell, then apply `gridCellClasses` (task 46). Children rendered in grid mode do NOT use absolute position classes — the grid system positions them.

title: Implement text inline style converter for TextLeaf
description: Create `src/converter/shapes/text.ts`. Implement `textLeafToClasses(leaf: TextLeaf): { classes: string; style: string }`. Map: `fontSize` → `text-[Npx]`, `fontWeight` → `font-[N]`, `fontStyle: 'italic'` → `italic`, `textDecoration: 'underline'` → `underline`, `textDecoration: 'line-through'` → `line-through`, `textTransform: 'uppercase'` → `uppercase`, `textTransform: 'lowercase'` → `lowercase`, `textTransform: 'capitalize'` → `capitalize`, `letterSpacing` → inline `letter-spacing: Nem`, `lineHeight` → inline `line-height: N`. For `fontFamily`, use inline style `font-family: '...'`.

title: Implement text leaf fill color conversion
description: In `src/converter/shapes/text.ts`, implement `textLeafColorClass(leaf: TextLeaf): string`. Reads `leaf.fills` — text fills work the same as shape fills but set the text color. For solid color fills, return `text-[#color]` or `text-[rgba(...)]`. If multiple fills are present or a gradient fill is used, fall back to a Tailwind arbitrary `text-[color]` for the first fill only (CSS `color` only accepts a single value; gradients on text require `-webkit-background-clip: text` which is an advanced inline style — emit that as a fallback).

title: Implement ParagraphNode to HTML paragraph element
description:
In `src/converter/shapes/text.ts`, implement `renderParagraph(para: ParagraphNode): string`. Emit a `

` element. Apply paragraph-level text styles (same `TextInlineStyle` fields as on the leaf, acting as defaults for the paragraph). For each child `TextLeaf`, call the leaf renderer (task 49) and wrap each leaf in a `` with its computed classes and styles. If all leaves have identical styles, hoist those styles to the `

` and omit the `` wrappers.

title: Implement TextShape renderer composing the full rich-text tree
description: In `src/converter/shapes/text.ts`, implement `renderText(shape: TextShape, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. If `shape.content` is null, render an empty `<div>`. Otherwise, walk `content.children` (paragraph sets) → `paragraphSet.children` (paragraphs) → paragraphs → text leaves. Wrap everything in an outer `<div>` with absolute position, width, height, rotation, opacity, and blend mode classes. For `growType === 'auto-width'` omit the width constraint; for `'auto-height'` omit the height constraint.

title: Implement typography reference resolution for text nodes
description: In `src/converter/shapes/text.ts`, update `textLeafToClasses` to handle `typographyRefId` and `typographyRefFile`. When a leaf references a typography, the inline style fields on the leaf itself override the typography defaults — so the inline fields are always authoritative. If a leaf has `typographyRefId` but no inline `fontSize`, that means the font properties come from the referenced typography. Accept an optional `typographies: Record<string, Typography>` lookup as a parameter and merge typography defaults before applying inline overrides.

title: Implement the main renderShape dispatcher routing to per-type renderers
description: Create `src/converter/render.ts`. Implement `renderShape(shape: Shape, parent: Shape | null, objects: Record<string, Shape>, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. Use a `switch` on `shape.type` to dispatch to `renderRect`, `renderCircle`, `renderImage`, `renderPath`, `renderBool`, `renderSvgRaw`, `renderGroup`, `renderFrame`, `renderText`. Pass children (resolved from `objects` via `getChildren`) to renderers that need them. This is the single recursive entry point — each renderer calls `renderShape` recursively for its children.

title: Implement component instance flattening in the shape dispatcher
description: In `src/converter/render.ts`, add handling for shapes with `componentId` set. Penpot component instances are regular shapes in the `objects` map — they just carry component linkage metadata. The dispatcher should treat them identically to their type (frame/group/etc.) and render their children normally. Add a comment noting that live component sync is not supported — instances are rendered as static HTML. No special behavior is needed beyond recognizing they exist.

title: Implement renderPage function that converts a full Penpot Page to HTML body content
description: Create `src/converter/page.ts`. Implement `renderPage(page: Page, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. Use `buildTree(page.objects)` to get the root shape. Call `renderShape(root, null, page.objects, ctx)` to produce the HTML. The root frame should be rendered with `relative` positioning and the page background color (from `page.options?.background`) applied as a `bg-[#color]` class or inline style on the wrapper div.

title: Implement convertShape for exporting a single shape subtree as a standalone HTML snippet
description: In `src/converter/index.ts`, implement `convertShape(shape: Shape, allObjects: Record<string, Shape>, ctx: ConverterContext): string`. This renders only the given shape and its descendants (not the full page). Useful for exporting a specific component or artboard. The root shape should use `relative` positioning (`position: relative`), not `absolute`. Return the HTML string without a full document wrapper (no `<html>` or `<body>` tags — just the rendered div tree).

title: Implement a file-based ImageResolver that maps Penpot image IDs to local file paths
description: Create `src/converter/resolvers/fileResolver.ts`. Export `createFileResolver(baseDir: string): (id: Uuid) => string` that returns a function which builds a file path like `baseDir/images/id.png` and returns it as a `file://` URL. This lets users point the converter at a directory where they have pre-downloaded Penpot media assets. If the file does not exist, return a `data:image/png;base64,` placeholder (a 1×1 transparent PNG in base64) to avoid broken images.

title: Implement a Penpot API ImageResolver that fetches image URLs from the Penpot REST API
description: Create `src/converter/resolvers/apiResolver.ts`. Export `createApiResolver(apiBase: string, fileId: Uuid, authToken: string): (id: Uuid) => string` that constructs a Penpot media URL for a given image ID. The URL pattern is `{apiBase}/api/rpc/command/get-file-object-thumbnails?file-id={fileId}&object-id={id}` (or the appropriate Penpot media endpoint). This resolver is synchronous — it just builds the URL string; no fetch is performed during rendering.

title: Handle shapes with both a transform matrix and a rotation value
description: In `src/converter/visual/position.ts`, update the transform/rotation logic. Penpot shapes can have both `rotation` (degrees) and a non-identity `transform` matrix. The correct CSS should be `transform: rotate(Ndeg) matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f)` — combining both. Implement `combinedTransformStyle(shape: ShapeCommon): string` that builds the final CSS `transform` property, composing rotation and matrix if both are present, emitting only the relevant part if only one is present, and emitting nothing if neither applies.

title: Handle fixed-scroll shapes (viewport-pinned elements)
description: In `src/converter/visual/position.ts`, handle `shape.fixedScroll === true`. When a shape has `fixedScroll` set, it is intended to stay fixed in the viewport during prototype playback. In HTML, emit `fixed` instead of `absolute` for its positioning class. This only applies to direct children of the root frame — nested shapes with `fixedScroll` should be treated as `absolute`.

title: Handle multiple fills using CSS layered backgrounds
description: Update `src/converter/visual/fills.ts`. Currently `fillsToOutput` handles one fill. Extend it to stack multiple fills using CSS `background` shorthand with comma-separated layers. Penpot renders fills bottom-to-top (index 0 is bottom). In CSS, the first listed layer is on top — so reverse the order. Emit the combined background as a single inline style property. Note: mixing `bg-[...]` Tailwind classes with inline `background` styles conflicts — prefer inline style when multiple fills are present.

title: Handle locked and blocked shapes
description: In `src/converter/render.ts`, handle `shape.locked` and `shape.blocked`. These are Penpot editor-only flags (locked shapes cannot be selected; blocked shapes cannot be edited). For the HTML output, they have no visual effect — add an HTML comment `<!-- locked -->` or `<!-- blocked -->` as an attribute/data attribute `data-penpot-locked="true"` on the element for informational purposes. This is purely cosmetic metadata.

title: Preserve shape names as data attributes for debugging
description: In `src/converter/render.ts`, add `data-penpot-name` and `data-penpot-id` HTML attributes to every rendered element using `shape.name` and `shape.id`. This makes the generated HTML much easier to inspect and debug — developers can see which Penpot shape each DOM element corresponds to. Sanitize the name by escaping it with `escapeHtml` before embedding.

title: Remove any reference to tailwindMode
description: Remove any usage of `tailwindMode`. This includes removing any conditional logic or class generation that depends on `tailwindMode`. The render must only return html without wrappers. So including cdn or not is up to the user of the library. The converter should be agnostic to how the output is used.
